title: PowderCore
description: Adds three tiers of Crusher blocks that turn raw materials into 2x powder, which can then be smelted into ingots.
body:
# **PowderCore**
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

This mod adds three tiers of Crusher blocks that turn raw materials into powder, giving double output. In return, crushing takes time, and the powder can only be smelted in a Blast Furnace to turn it into ingots.

<details>
<summary>
Items:
</summary>

These items can only be smelted in a Blast Furnace:
  
  Netherite Powder → Netherite Scraps
  
  Iron Powder → Irong Ingot
  
  Gold Powder  → Gold Ingot
  
  Copper Powder → Copper Ingot
</details>
